visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair, wearing a black cap and vest, is seen from behind standing in a modern doorway holding a cardboard box. Inside the apartment, a woman with long blonde hair and a white top looks at the box with a confused facial expression. (2) The blonde woman sits on a plush white chair, leaning over the cardboard box to open it with her hands. (3) A close-up shot shows the woman's hand holding four glossy photocards featuring a female celebrity, with the cardboard box and bubble wrap visible in the background. (4) The blonde woman holds up a silver Skintific box and an orange serum bottle, smiling and looking directly at the camera. (5) A static shot displays the Skintific product box alongside two orange serum bottles on a textured surface. (6) The woman holds the product box again, pointing to the text on the front with her right hand. (7) A close-up reveals an orange serum bottle being held; the woman points to a white dividing line on the lower part of the container. (8) The woman's hand presses the pump of the bottle twice, then vigorously shakes the orange liquid inside. (9) A close-up shows the clear serum being pumped onto the back of a hand and then rubbed into the skin with fingers. (10) The woman, now wearing a purple striped headband, applies the serum to her cheeks and forehead using both hands. (11) A split-screen montage appears, labeled 'Before' and 'After,' showing the woman's face from the side and front to compare skin clarity. (12) The woman demonstrates a yellow plastic protective sleeve, sliding it over the orange serum bottle. (13) The video ends with the woman holding the serum bottle in one hand and fanning out the four photocards in her other hand, smiling at the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice (Voice A) speaks with a friendly, high-pitched tone, followed by another female voice (Voice B) sounding surprised. Low-level ambient room tone is present. (2) Voice B mutters at a fast speech rate while the audible rustling of cardboard and plastic indicates unboxing. No BGM yet. (3) An energetic, upbeat pop BGM with a strong electronic beat (124 BPM) swells. Voice B exclaims with high arousal about 'Minnie cards.' (4) Voice B explains product benefits with clear articulation and professional tone. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) Sound of two distinct metallic clicks as the pump is pressed. This is followed by a rhythmic liquid sloshing sound as the bottle is shaken. (6) Voice B's tone becomes more descriptive as the sound of skin rubbing is heard. Digital 'ding' sound effects highlight key text points. (7) Voice B talks enthusiastically about recommending the product, with a high arousal level and positive valence. BGM continues at a steady volume. (8) Voice B concludes with a call to action regarding Watsons and Shopee. BGM stays upbeat until a clean hard cut at the end.
